values.binNote: The bin has no per-tick AP ratio row; only NasusE#TotalDotDamage (tooltip only) states the aggregate, whose ap coefficient 0.6 = 0.12 x Duration=5, consistent with the wiki's per-tick 12% AP over 5 ticks/seconds.

values.meaning: Duration of the lingering fire's damage/armor reduction
values.quote: The fire then remains for 5 seconds

mechanics.claim: Sight is granted immediately, but the initial damage lands 0.25 seconds after cast, and only then does the lingering fire begin.
mechanics.quote: and, after a {{rutngt|0.25}} delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within

mechanics.claim: The tooltip's total DoT damage is 10 times the per-tick value over a 5 second duration, implying ticks occur twice per second (every 0.5s) rather than once per second as the description text states.
The lingering fire (and its armor reduction/damage zone) persists on the ground for 1 extra second after its duration ends.
The initial cast also grants vision of the area for an estimated 2.5 seconds.
mechanics.quote: granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|centered at the location}} for {{tt|{{fd|2.5}} seconds|Estimated}}
